# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. - **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy with a big, round fat face and small blue eyes. His ears stick out like flaps, a feature considered round and objectionable enough that it was suggested he sleep with a rubber band around his head to train them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a very serious young man who aspires to become a minister, though he acknowledges it would be easier to work as a carpenter. He harbors anxieties about his academic performance, notably feeling in his bones that he will fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_

## History

Prior to his higher education, Moody Spurgeon MacPherson engaged in a fight with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after claiming that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs. He later attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and pursued a career as a schoolteacher upon leaving the institution. Following his time at Queen's, he went on to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) alongside his fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P7](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXX.
